Working together

Down to earth, from the start.

01 / LISTEN

First, your everyday life.

We talk about how you use the garden, what you love and what isn’t working. No need to arrive with a finished brief.

02 / DESIGN

A plan with a purpose.

We explore layouts, materials and planting, then refine a clear direction together. You’ll know what comes next.

03 / GROW

Good things take root.

We help turn the design into a garden and leave you with practical guidance to care for it as it grows.

“We wanted a garden we could actually live in, not just look at. The design made space for both.”
